activities_budget.sourceTitle: Revision Of Heritage Facilities Admission Fees - National Museums of Kenya
activities_budget.evidenceText: National Museums of Kenya fee table lists Nairobi National Museum adult admission as USD 18 for foreigners outside Africa (USD 9 for residents/rest of Africa); the snippet does not state tax treatment.
activities_budget.referencePeriod: Fees effective 7 May 2026; crawled three months ago
activities_budget.searchQuery: Nairobi Kenya standard attraction adult ticket price per person taxes
activities_budget.reason: Exact Nairobi attraction and adult per-person price are present, but inclusion or exclusion of taxes is not stated.
